sd.drafted: drafted until the line makes it solid
sd.line.chip: The whole die, drawn before anything is made: its pads, the units that compute and where the memory sits. Arrange it: packing the units close shortens the trips, and piles up the heat.
sd.line.block: Your block inside the first unit, its cells in their rows and the wires between them; the solid wire is its longest path. Scramble it, let it settle, drag a cell: the wire and the time follow.
sd.line.gate: Each cell as it will be printed: two strips of silicon, two gates across them, a rail for power above and one for ground below.
sd.line.switch: One cell, close: the gates you see here are where the line will make its switches.
sd.line.empty: Nothing is drawn on this die yet: your block waits for a design that does its job.
sd.line.broken: Your design does not do its job yet, so the line will not make it: its block is drawn red.
sd.line.switchOff: Your switch never turns off, so nothing above it can be made: its gates are drawn red.
sd.fig.trip: a value travels {d} mm to memory
sd.cover.found: a wrong answer, in a corner
sd.line.late: Your block misses its clock: its longest path is drawn red. The line makes it anyway, and every die fails its test for speed.
sd.shuttle: or share a shuttle: 273 designs rode one chip
sd.ag.arr: {shape}, {where}: {c} °C cooler, and a value travels {d} mm less to memory.
sd.ag.none: It tried all sixteen arrangements: none is both cooler and shorter than yours.
sd.ag.place: A settled placement: {w} sites less wire, its longest path {p} ps faster.
sd.ag.nonePlace: It tried to settle your placement and found none both shorter and faster.
sd.fab.strays: this copy's gate strays: it switches late
sd.fab.stopped: Your design stops the line here: nothing is printed, so every wafer leaves bare.
sd.fab.machine.crystal: the puller: a crystal drawn from the melt, turning
sd.fab.machine.deposit: the chamber: a film settling on the wafer
sd.fab.machine.print: the scanner: light over six mirrors, through your mask, onto the wafer
sd.fab.machine.etch: the etcher: plasma, ions falling straight down
sd.fab.machine.implant: the implanter: a beam of atoms, bent and swept
sd.fab.machine.wires: the wiring: layers laid one on another, polished flat
sd.fab.machine.test: the prober: needles come down on every die
sd.fab.line.crystal: A crystal pulled from molten silicon and sliced: your design waits for Print.
sd.fab.line.deposit: A film laid on the wafer, atom by atom; the air's specks land on it too.
sd.fab.line.print: Your masks printed into the resist, one die at a time: the copies spread as the light's photons fall.
sd.fab.line.etch: What Print left, cut straight down: each copy's gate stands at its own width, and one that strays too far switches late.
sd.fab.line.implant: Atoms shot into the silicon beside the gates, where the switches' sources and drains will be.
sd.fab.line.wires: Contacts and layers of metal laid over the switches, joining your cells.
sd.fab.line.test: Every die probed: a speck or a late path fails it, and what a good chip costs follows.
sd.care.both: One setting of your stack, the line's care, sets the dose and the air together for now.
